story.fullStory:
Madness's "Our House" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Our House" is a song by the English ska and pop band Madness and was written by second lead vocalist Chas Smash and guitarist Chris Foreman.

It was released as the lead single from their fourth studio album, The Rise & Fall, on 12 November 1982.

The song charted within the top ten in several countries, and it was the band's biggest hit on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.
